actions.action: Assign the Plant Cutting work type priority 1-2 on a colonist from Day 1, and check that harvested crops are actually being hauled to the kitchen and cooked. A harvest in the field is not food: without plant cutting and hauling, raw crops stay in the field and food days keep falling even when a harvest lands. Keep the cooking bill on a target count (10-12 meals), not 'forever', so the cook returns to the fields. Verify with the food-days readout, not the raw resource count.
actions.rationale: run-007-adv-cassandra: the colony ended in Starvation with 2.2 days of food and Steven Wilcox's mood at 17% (major break risk). Food days decayed from 7.2 (Day 1) to 3.5 (Day 3) to 1.5 (Day 10) even though a rice harvest landed on 1st of Jugust and the food count jumped from 15 to 205 units, which was consumed within a single day. The player confirmed the cause: plant-cutting work was not assigned a high enough priority, so harvested crops were never processed into meals. This is a different failure from L-0016 (too few crops planted): here the crops existed and were not converted into food. L-0016 was retrieved on 7 of 14 advice days during this run and the colony still starved, so planting volume alone is not the lever.
